title: Configuration API
description: a client side Config API mod that is like every other configAPI but well idk why you would wanna use this
body:
ConfigurationAPI is just a normal ConfigAPI but with a cool coat of paint. cus i like the UI

ConfigurationAPI has support for: bools, text, nums, sliders, items, and colors.

Dev Wiki: [https://github.com/RedstoneMaster011/ConfigAPI](https://github.com/RedstoneMaster011/ConfigAPI)
